notes: Corrected: the supplied *men* is moved from δεῖ to ἐργάζεσθαι. δεῖ is impersonal and has no subject to supply; *men* is the unexpressed subject of the infinitive, which rule 74 makes a helper on the infinitive rather than on the finite verb governing it. 13:33 reads the same lemma the same way, leaving δεῖ → *must* with no subject word of its own, so this is rule 24's habit within the chapter.

ἀρχισυνάγωγος → *ruler of the synagogue* is headed on *synagogue* as the compound's core, on the model of rule 66's πιθανολογίᾳ → *persuasiveness of speech*; a head on *ruler* remains the competing reading. οἰκοδεσπότης at 13:25 heads on *master* by the same test, its core being δεσπότης.
ἀποκριθεὶς … ἔλεγεν is discontinuous in the ASV, the participle's English standing at t018 well after the intervening causal clause.
